channel.title: Wire — Programming
channel.description: Programming from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Go 1.27 is released
item.description: Go 1.27 adds generic methods, encoding/json/v2 package, uuid package, faster memory allocation, goroutine leak profiles, and more. (4 sources: goblog, hackernews, lobsters, rprogramming)

item.title: Enabling the next-generation trait solver on nightly
item.description: After nearly 4 years of active development, the next-generation trait solver is close to stabilization. We are enabling it by default on nightly to surface any remaining issues and plan to stabilize it in the next months. (2 sources: lobsters, rustblog)

item.title: VoidZero Releases Vite+ Beta: A Unified Web Toolchain Behind a Single Command
item.description: VoidZero has launched the beta of Vite+, a unified web development toolchain. It combines runtime, package management, and essential frontend tools under a single command. Vite+ supports various projects and is open source. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Espressif releases Linux BSP for ESP32-S31 RISC-V boards
item.description: The ESP32-S31 microprocessor is getting Linux support from Espressif Systems. The ESP32-S31 dual-core RISC-V microprocessor was first unveiled in March, (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: The August 17 outage, and the work ahead
item.description: An update on the August 17 outage and the steps we're taking to improve reliability. The post The August 17 outage, and the work ahead appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (3 sources: githubblog, hackernews, rprogramming)

item.title: I accidentally logged hundreds of thousands of phone calls to military bases
item.description: How an expired nameserver let me take over e164.arpa zones for multiple territories, and why I probably should have checked my logs sooner. (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: Felony Bench
item.description: Felony Bench is the most important benchmark of our time, some are saying, counting the number of questionable decisions made by AI agents. We might need a Pandemic Bench soon... (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: Canada suspends trade negotiations with USA and match tariffs dollar for dollar
item.description: We have recognised from the beginning that America has changed, and that we will not return to our old relationship. Our government understood, before many, that America is altering all its trade relationships. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Kagi added a setting for removing paywalled links from search results
item.description: Better search results with no ads. Welcome to Kagi (pronounced kah-gee), a paid search engine that gives power back to the user. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Ich möchte eine Alternative für Tinder, Bumble, Hinge und Jodel anbieten
item.description: Hallo zusammen, ich finde die aktuellen Datingapps Menschen unwürdig und versuche, meine eigene App zu etablieren. (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: You should never be angry at work
item.description: I try not to give a lot of prescriptive advice about working in tech companies. There are many ways to be successful, and every company works differently. If… (1 source: lobsters)
